# Enterprise-only endpoints called by the dashboard that still return an untyped dict.

# The personal ratchet cannot see these: _register_routes gates the tenant /
# rbac / sso / quotas / n8n / licenses / compliance routers behind
# FeatureFlag.MULTI_USER, so with no enterprise license they are absent from
# app.openapi() and the personal gate's `matched` set never contains them.
# Burn-down list for tests/test_enterprise_response_models.py: delete a line
# when the endpoint declares a response_model. The gate fails in both
